forbidden.name: no-cross-module-internals
forbidden.comment: Only contract folders (errors, events, useCases, stores, presentations/views) are accessible across modules. models, repositories, transformers, validators, services, helpers, engine, worklets, and presentations/hooks/components/renderers/context are module-private.

forbidden.name: presentation-stores-private-intra
forbidden.comment: Within a module, only that module's presentations layer may import its stores.

forbidden.name: presentation-stores-private-cross
forbidden.comment: presentations/stores/ is module-private and cannot be imported by other modules. For cross-module shared state, use a Store<T> at the business layer (stores/ outside presentations/).

forbidden.name: presentations-hooks-private-cross
forbidden.comment: Presentation hooks are module-private and cannot be imported by other modules. Expose behaviour through useCases/ or presentations/views/ instead.

forbidden.name: models-private-cross
forbidden.comment: models/ is module-private. Export a DTO from useCases/ for cross-module type contracts. Shared primitives (TrackId, Beats, Decibels, etc.) belong in src/shared/types/.

forbidden.name: validators-private-cross
forbidden.comment: validators/ is module-private. Aggregate invariant enforcement is an internal concern. Other modules should call the owning module's useCases/, which internally invoke validators.

forbidden.name: services-private-cross
forbidden.comment: services/ is module-private. Stateless cross-entity domain logic is an internal concern. Other modules should call the owning module's useCases/, which internally invoke services.

forbidden.name: transformers-private-cross
forbidden.comment: transformers/ is module-private. Mapping logic is an internal concern. Other modules should use DTOs exported from useCases/.

forbidden.name: renderers-private-cross
forbidden.comment: presentations/renderers/ is module-private. Canvas/WebGL/WebGPU drawing code is presentation-layer I/O scoped to the owning module.

forbidden.name: context-private-cross
forbidden.comment: presentations/context/ is module-private. Ephemeral UI state (selection, scroll) must never be shared across module boundaries.

forbidden.name: components-private-cross
forbidden.comment: presentations/components/ is module-private. Expose reusable UI through presentations/views/ (contract) instead.

forbidden.name: repositories-only-from-usecases
forbidden.comment: Within a module, only useCases/ may import that module's repositories/.

forbidden.name: presentations-no-direct-io
forbidden.comment: The presentations layer cannot directly access repositories/.

forbidden.name: engine-private-cross
forbidden.comment: engine/ is module-private. Access audio engine behaviour through useCases/ contracts. Never import AudioEngine, TrackNode, or other engine classes from another module.

forbidden.name: worklets-isolated
forbidden.comment: AudioWorkletProcessor files in worklets/ run on the audio thread and are isolated. They may not import from useCases/, repositories/, stores/, or any module layer.

forbidden.name: transformers-are-pure
forbidden.comment: Transformers must be pure functions. They may not import from repositories/, presentations/stores/, or useCases/.

forbidden.name: components-no-usecase-access
forbidden.comment: Components cannot import use cases directly. Access business logic through hooks or views.

forbidden.name: components-no-store-access
forbidden.comment: Components cannot access stores directly. Receive state via props from views or hooks.

forbidden.name: tauri-ipc-only-in-repositories
forbidden.comment: Tauri IPC (invoke, listen) may only be called from repositories/. Use cases and presentations must go through a repository adapter.

forbidden.name: src-to-application-restrictions
forbidden.comment: From application/, only contract folders (errors, events, useCases, presentations/views) and src/helpers/ are accessible.

forbidden.name: shared-no-module-imports
forbidden.comment: src/shared/ may only contain pure types and pure functions. It must never import from src/modules/.

forbidden.name: not-to-spec
forbidden.comment: This module depends on a spec (test) file. The sole responsibility of a spec file is to test code. If there's something in a spec that's of use to other modules, it doesn't have that single responsibility anymore. Factor it out into a separate utility/helper or a mock.

forbidden.name: not-to-dev-dep
forbidden.comment: This module depends on an npm package from the 'devDependencies' section of your package.json. It looks like something that ships to production, though. To prevent problems with npm packages that aren't there on production declare it (only!) in the 'dependencies' section of your package.json. If this module is development only - add it to the from.pathNot re of the not-to-dev-dep rule.

forbidden.name: optional-deps-used
forbidden.comment: This module depends on an npm package that is declared as an optional dependency in your package.json. As this makes sense in limited situations only, it's flagged here. If you're using an optional dependency here by design - add an exception to your dependency-cruiser configuration.

forbidden.name: peer-deps-used
forbidden.comment: This module depends on an npm package that is declared as a peer dependency in your package.json. This makes sense if your package is e.g. a plugin, but in other cases - maybe not so much. If the use of a peer dependency is intentional add an exception to your dependency-cruiser configuration.
